global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu and crisp menma. A large nori sheet rests atop the noodles, all served in a white bowl on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture variations.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly flared rim, showing subtle light reflections.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, thick, and swirling around yellow noodles with visible specks and slight surface oil sheen.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and curved handle, tapering to a pointed tip.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with a slightly uneven surface and visible grainy details.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: golden-brown, tender, crescent-shaped slice with glistening surface and visible marbling.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with irregular curved shapes and visible fibrous texture.
